why_relevant: Second free mirror/aggregator of the commercial register with company profiles, officer histories and financial summaries; useful as a cross-check when one aggregator's parsing of a filing is ambiguous.

source_name: Financni-subjekty.penize.cz – mirror of ČNB regulated-entity lists
why_relevant: Commercial re-publication of the ČNB register in a far more scrapable HTML form than JERRS, useful as a fallback or cross-check when JERRS/open-data access is awkward. Secondary source: never authoritative, may lag, and licensing for reuse is unclear — treat ČNB as the system of record.

Country-filtered feed of CZ fintech/banking-tech news plus a press-release channel used directly by vendors (e.g. Temenos/Komercni banka Transact win). Country page acts as a pointer and a low-cost monitoring endpoint.

source_name: ICT UNIE — Pracovní skupiny a Orgány
why_relevant: Working groups and board composition show which IT vendors lead on eGovernment, digital identity, cybersecurity and data topics — a direct read on which suppliers are positioned on regulation and public-sector digitalisation that spills into banking (eID, bankID, NIS2).

source_name: Seamless Europe (payments/fintech/banking expo, Munich) – LinkedIn and event presence
why_relevant: Named in the cell brief as a delegation target. ~5,000 attendees, 400 speakers, 200 exhibitors (10-11 Sept, Messe Munich). Its exhibitor roster is the nearest large European payments floor to CZ vendors and a plausible venue for CZ delegations; the LinkedIn page is the reliably reachable index while the canonical event domain was not confirmed in this pass.

source_name: aRecenze.cz – consumer-facing bank/payment incident and review coverage
why_relevant: Aggregates consumer-perspective reporting on bank app outages, retailer payment launches (Cvak at Lidl, naming supported banks) and self-checkout changes; fast-moving demand-side sentiment layer that often surfaces incidents before official confirmation.

Aggregator adding derived signals — estimated revenue (tržby), risk flags, vehicle fleets, contacts — on top of register data; a cheap proxy scale indicator for small CZ payment vendors that file abbreviated accounts.

Economia (publisher of HN, Ekonom) runs a steady stream of paid banking/payments events — e.g. 'Inovace v platebních kartách'. Each event page carries a programme and partner block, and the publisher's commercial interest means the partner list is complete and dated. Also the organiser side of the HN bank awards.

source_name: EGAP — Veřejné zakázky (Export Guarantee and Insurance Company)
why_relevant: State export-credit insurer; a financial institution whose core insurance/underwriting and payment IT procurement is legally disclosed. Publishes via Tender arena profile.

source_name: Fio banka – O nás / organizational and corporate disclosures
why_relevant: Fio is notable for building its own banking software in-house (Fio's own IT arm), so its owned pages and reports are the only evidence of an insourced-stack outlier in the CZ market — an important negative datapoint for vendor addressable-market work.
Independent search interface over the same statutory contract data; useful as a redundancy path and sometimes for better full-text search of contract subjects than the official UI.

source_name: Tuesday Business Network – FIN (R)Evoluce conference page
why_relevant: 11th edition (Feb 2025, Hotel Jalta Prague) with an explicitly published partner list — EFG CZ, Salesforce, SOFTEC — and media partners Cardmag, CFOworld, Euro.cz, Ekonomický magazín, Finance.cz, SBK. Small, cheap-to-monitor page that names the exact vendor set courting CZ financial institutions on AI and new payment methods.

source_name: VímVíc.cz – employer profiles and vacancies (e.g. ČSOB)
why_relevant: CZ employer-review/career aggregator; consolidates a bank's vacancies plus employee commentary, giving both hiring signals and soft internal-organisation detail (team names, tooling complaints) that hint at platform programmes.

Czech Post operates postal payment orders, cash services, Czech POINT and (historically) Poštovní spořitelna-linked counters; it is a major buyer of payment/terminal/counter systems. Page routes to its Tender arena profile.
